about.heading: About Me
about.body:
Hi, I am Kristina!

I am into various fields, including psychology, literature, and philosophy. I also love to explore things like poetry, debating, mystery novels, puzzles, typology, stand-up comedy, and creative writing.

If you want a stereotypical description: INFP. Ravenclaw. Aries.

Feel free to contact me and chat about anything!
